title: Senior Enterprise Network Architect
description:
Role: Senior Enterprise Network Architect
Duration: 12+ months contract
Location: Downey, CA (Onsite)
 
Position Description:

  • An Enterprise Network Architect designs, implements, and maintains complex enterprise network infrastructures across multi-site and hybrid environments.
  • The architect brings deep expertise in advanced network engineering, with a strong focus on BGP, Cisco routing and switching, high-availability architectures, and network security.
  • The Enterprise Network Architect architects and operates cloud network environments across major platforms including AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and GCP.
  • This includes designing VPCs/VNets, configuring cloud routing and peering, implementing advanced security frameworks, and deploying network automation.
 
Skills Required:
  • A Senior Network Architect should possess a robust technical and strategic skills, with deep expertise in enterprise network design, cloud networking, and security; advanced knowledge of BGP; the ability to build resilient, high-availability network infrastructures.
  • Expertise in Cisco networking technologies, including routers, switches, and data center solutions such as Cisco Nexus, VXLAN, and ACI.
  • Expertise in BGP protocol configuration, including route propagation, route maps, attributes, and policy-based routing.
  • Expertise in firewalls in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Proficiency with identifying and resolving complex BGP issues such as route leaks, path selection anomalies, and peering conflicts.
  • Proficiency with designing resilient network architectures with high availability, failover, and redundancy strategies for mission-critical systems.
  • Proficiency with designing and implementing hybrid cloud connectivity using Megaport, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, and Site-to-Site VPNs.
  •  Proficiency with designing secure network architectures.
  • Strong understanding of public cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native networking and security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), network segmentation, encryption, and compliance with industry standards and regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of access control policies, risk mitigation strategies, firewall configurations, and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
 
Experience Required:
  • Six (6) years of experience within the last eight (8) years in designing, implementing, and maintaining complex enterprise network infrastructure, including multi-site and hybrid environments.
  • Six (6) years of experience within the last eight (8) years in configuring and managing BGP, Cisco routing and switching, security, data center architecture, and high-availability design.
  • Three (3) years of experience within the last five (5) years in architecting and managing cloud environments across multiple platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and GCP), including VPC/VNet design, cloud routing, peering, security, and network automation.

             
Education Required:
This classification requires the possession of Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE), AND AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Azure Administrator Associate.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
Executive Coordinator – Contract-to-Hire (Remote, US – Central/Eastern Time Zone)
Location: Remote (Must reside in Central or Eastern Time Zone, U.S.)
Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire
Contract Duration: 3 Months (with strong intent to convert to Full-Time)
Travel: No travel during contract. Occasional travel (approx. 5%) after full-time conversion.
Industry: Healthcare (experience not required)
 
About the Role
We are seeking a highly experienced Executive Coordinator to support senior leaders (VP-level and above) in a dynamic, matrixed organization. This role is part of a lean and collaborative administrative team supporting our Central Zone leadership, including a newly appointed Zone General Manager.
This is not an entry-level role — we are looking for a senior-level administrative professional who brings experience, judgment, and the ability to operate with limited information in a fast-paced, executive environment. The role requires the ability to manage multiple leaders, communicate with confidence, and take ownership of priorities while staying flexible to the evolving needs of the team.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide daily administrative support to 4–5 executives, including Vice Presidents and the Central Zone General Manager.
  • Manage complex, high-volume calendars across multiple time zones (primarily Central and Eastern).
  • Schedule internal and external meetings, prioritize requests, and resolve conflicts independently.
  • Coordinate occasional team offsite logistics, including venue booking, meals, and vendor coordination (small-scale events only).
  • Book travel through Egencia / American Express GBT (as needed — some executives self-manage travel).
  • Act as liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, including other admins and cross-functional leaders.
  • Support ad-hoc administrative projects (e.g., invoice submissions, purchase orders via Workday, shared calendar updates).
  • Provide backup coverage for other executive coordinators during PTO or peak periods.
  • Proactively anticipate executive needs and bring solutions, not just questions.
 
Qualifications
Must-Have Requirements
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience supporting C-level or VP-level executives in a corporate environment.
  • Proven ability to manage 4 or more senior executives simultaneously — strong multitasking skills are essential.
  • Exceptional proficiency in Microsoft Outlook (calendar, email, scheduling).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to represent executives professionally.
  • Collaborative mindset; willing to step in, take ownership, and support broader team goals.
  • Coachable and open to feedback, with a professional approach to adapting to new systems and processes.
  • Ability to work with limited direction, ask the right questions, and operate independently.
  • Must reside in Central or Eastern Time Zone and be authorized to work in the U.S.
Nice-to-Have (Preferred, Not Required)
  • Experience supporting sales executives or account management teams.
  • Prior use of Egencia / Amex GBT for corporate travel booking.
  • Familiarity with Workday for invoice and purchase order submissions.
  • Light experience in small-scale event or meeting planning.
  • Background in healthcare or hospital systems (a bonus, but not required).
 
Tools You’ll Use
  • Microsoft Outlook – essential for calendar and inbox management
  • Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel (basic proficiency required)
  • Workday – for submitting invoices and creating purchase orders
  • Egencia / Amex GBT – for booking and managing travel (training available)
 
Work Environment & Team Structure
  • Join a tight-knit admin team of 4 Executive Coordinators, each supporting different zones across the U.S.
  • You will primarily support the Central Zone, reporting to a leader with 8+ years in the company and deep team knowledge.
  • Expect weekly team meetings, shared responsibilities, and high collaboration across admins.
  • Culture values mutual support, accountability, and professionalism.
  • You’ll work closely with a newly appointed General Manager, helping them get established within the organization.
 
Travel Requirements
  • No travel is required during the contract period.
  • After conversion to full-time, occasional travel (approx. 5% annually) may be required to support regional offsites or team meetings.
  • Travel expenses are reimbursed under company policy for full-time employees.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally is a requirement for full-time conversion.
 
Interview Process
We take a conversational, real-world approach to interviews — no generic Q&A.
  1. Initial Interview – with Hiring Manager (an experienced executive admin)
  2. Second Interview – with another senior team manager
  3. Final Conversation – with Hiring Manager (only for top candidate prior to offer)
Expect to discuss real experiences: how you've managed executive relationships, handled competing priorities, and navigated complex environments.
 
Contract-to-Hire Details
  • Initial contract duration: 3 months
  • Hiring Manager’s intent is to convert the right candidate early (within 2 months) if performance is strong.
  • Regular check-ins and coaching will be provided.
  • If it’s not a fit within the first month, the contract may be concluded — transparency and feedback are core to the process.
 
What Success Looks Like
  • You confidently manage multiple VP-level calendars with limited oversight.
  • You communicate clearly, follow through on tasks, and represent the team with professionalism.
  • You proactively solve problems before they reach the executives.
  • You quickly learn company-specific processes and adapt to established systems.
  • You contribute to a strong, collaborative admin culture.
 
Important Notes
  • Candidates outside of the Central or Eastern Time Zones will not be considered.
  • Candidates must be willing to travel after full-time conversion — this is non-negotiable.
  • The goal is a long-term hire. This is not a short-term or try-and-see role.
 
How to Apply
Submit your resume with a brief summary of:
  • Number of executives you've supported simultaneously
  • Types of executives (e.g., C-suite, VP, Sales Leaders)
  • Experience coordinating travel and/or managing small offsites
  • Tools you’ve used (Outlook, Workday, etc.)

title: Test Technician
description:

  • Must assess product evaluation against NEC and UL/CSA standards. Review order write-ups, operate components, ensure product quality, work with other areas to ensure quality, and verify units to meet agency approvals.

  • Associate’s degree in electrical/mechanical engineering OR
  • Equivalent training from two-year technical school with emphasis in electrical applications OR
  • Combined knowledge and experience to equal two years

title: Civil Engineer III
description:
Civil Engineer III
Contract Duration: Contract through 09/14/2026(High potential for extension)
Location: Jackson, MI 49201
Travel: Expect to travel to construction sites 1-5 days per week.
 
 
Job Description:
Department Summary:
The Substation Engineering department plays a pivotal role in providing multi-disciplinary engineering design and leadership for high-voltage electric distribution projects, specifically for company-owned or operated substations across Michigan's lower peninsula. The team's focus includes in-house and consultant-driven designs for new substations, as well as repairs, upgrades, and other developments related to existing substations. Our work encompasses structural and civil designs, project development, spill compliance, permitting, code compliance, geotechnical analysis, procurement, and construction support.
The Senior Civil Engineer will be an integral part of this team and will specifically support capital projects in a civil engineering capacity.
 
Role Summary:
The Sr. Civil Engineer will be responsible for overseeing various aspects of civil engineering design and construction for several projects. Key responsibilities include:
  1. Identify & Scope Design/Construction Needs: Define the civil engineering scope required for project completion.
  2. Contract & Collaboration: Work with contractors and collaborate with engineering teams to ensure project scope is completed effectively.
  3. Technical Leadership: Provide expert engineering review and technical authority, ensuring that design and construction align with the project's objectives.
  4. Project Collaboration: Work closely with Project Managers and Project Engineers to support procurement, contracting, and other essential project steps.
  5. Project Closeout: Manage the closeout activities, including generating record drawings and test records.
 
The Sr. Civil Engineer will be the subject matter expert in civil engineering design and will represent Consumers Energy as the design authority. Regular updates regarding project status, risks, quality, cost, and schedule will be provided to supervisors.
 
Site Conditions & Safety Requirements:
  • Industrial Environments: Ability to work in heavy industrial environments, such as undeveloped wood sites, rough terrains, and rocky/ballast rock surfaces.
  • Electrical Safety: Work in electric substations and near live, unguarded electrical equipment. Safety is paramount.
  • Site Visits: Expect to travel to construction sites 1-5 days per week for activities like pre-engineering, milestone reviews, technical problem solving, quality inspections, and red-line walkdowns.
 
Key Skills & Experience:
  • Civil/Structural Design Knowledge: Experience in site design, stormwater management, pre-engineered metal building design, foundation design, structural steel design, and environmental permitting (wetlands, soil erosion, culverts, etc.). Proficiency in multiple areas is highly preferred.
  • Contract Documents: Experience in coordinating and developing contract documents, including engineering drawings and technical specifications, for both consulting and construction services.
  • Engineering Codes: Working knowledge of industry codes such as NESC, NEC, ASCE MOP 113, ASCE 7, IBC/MBC, AISC Steel Construction Manual, ACI 318, and AWS D1.1.
  • Software Proficiency: Experience with RISA, L-Pile, Civil3D, Microstation, ProjectWise, and SAP is preferred.
 
Personal Skills:
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
  • Strong communication skills to update team members and supervisors about project status, potential risks, and challenges.
  • Demonstrated engineering leadership and attention to safety.
 
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited program.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
